name: Inventory Stock Management System
description: Production-grade multi-branch inventory tracking system with WebSockets real-time updates, quantity reconciliation, multi-branch transfers, optimistic concurrency versioning, and transaction audit trails.
highlights: Reduced cutting stock reconciliation errors by 90% and optimized real-time stock computation performance.

name: Enterprise HRMS Platform
description: Full-stack internal HR management system for employee onboarding, leave management, payroll reporting, and performance tracking across enterprise teams.
highlights: Serving 100+ active internal users across multiple teams.

name: Enterprise Marketing & Sales CRM
description: Automated sales pipeline tracking & customer relationship manager featuring real-time data sync, cross-department reporting workflows, and analytics dashboard.
highlights: Automated cross-department operations, reducing manual reporting effort by 60%.

name: Real-Time Microservices Pub/Sub Hub
description: Distributed real-time message broker interface built with Node.js WebSockets and Redis Pub/Sub, engineered to scale server instances horizontally under high load.
highlights: Demonstrates pub/sub scaling, connection pooling, and optimistic state synchronization.
